claims.statement: Tom Allen was arrested in Cincinnati on 14 May 1869 on a charge of training for a prize fight in the State of Ohio.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen, the pugilist, was arrested to-day on a charge of training for a prize fight in the State of Ohio.

claims.statement: Tom Allen gave bonds of $500 (printed as £500) not to fight in Ohio within a year, and was released.
claims.excerpt: gave bonds in £500 not to fight in the State within a year, and was released.

claims.statement: After his release Tom Allen returned to his quarters at the Buckeye House to resume preparation for the fight with Mike McCoole.
